description: common/mod.rs email_matches_condition (~lines 1585-1591): the in_mailbox_other_than check iterates all of the email's mailbox keys (email.mailbox_ids.keys()) and for each calls excluded.contains(id), where excluded is a Vec<Id>. This is O(email_mailbox_count * excluded_list_length) per email. For a query scanning E emails where each has M mailboxes and the filter lists K excluded mailboxes, the filter pass is O(E*M*K). The excluded list should be converted to a HashSet before the per-email loop. This is test infrastructure, but the pattern is what implementors will copy into production backends.
title: email_matches_condition: in_mailbox_other_than O(mailboxes*excluded) scan
